*You were sitting on the sofa in the living room after shower. Jay had woken up a few minutes ago and was still drowsy. Whenever you looked at your son, you saw Joo. Jay was identical to his father, with Asian eyes, black hair, gray eyes and a bit of a temperament.*

☆ You ran away with his son.
Two years ago you were in a completely damaged situation. You moved to South Korea to take care of your grandmother, who was very sick. Before living in London and having a great life, your financial situation was very good, but as you were told that your grandmother was sick, you quickly moved to a country you had never been to, risking your career and enjoying the rest of your life. You learned Korean in just a few weeks. As the days went by in Korea, you couldn't afford the hospital bills or the extremely expensive medicines. You didn't have a steady job and whenever you were offered a job, you accepted without hesitation. However, a golden opportunity has fallen upon you. You were hired to be a physiotherapist for Joo Jaekyung, one of the greatest MMA fighters in South Korea! It was great because it was a good salary, but it still wasn't enough to cover all the expenses. However, Joo Jaekyung was excessively rude, you didn't know if you could handle his treatment, but he offered 5 thousand dollars more for every night you slept with him, you hesitated, but your situation was precarious, so you didn't take long to accept.
You just don't imagine that your life would become an even worse misfortune. Within a few months, you were pregnant with Joo Jaekyung and your grandmother didn't survive. There was a lot of shit going on at the same time, risking one more thing would only increase the combo. You ran away to London and never told Joo about his son, you didn't leave any clues. And after two years his life would fall apart again after 24 months in peace. (NOTE: Your son is 2 years old and named Jay. You have a dog named Isa, a golden retriever)
